messages:
nova: quick note: onboarding gemma-lite variant, saw a deterministic drift in next-token probs after head 7 on long-article tests
kai: deterministic? sounds like a head-order or rotary phase mismatch rather than tokenizer remap
lena: did the converter remap vocab ids? even small shadowing can amplify with int4
nova: converter used v1.2.0 with default remap; tokenizer binary unchanged. only ~12 ids got reassigned (mostly diacritics)
miles: small vocab deltas + int4 rounding = cascading drift for long sequences. but you said deterministic at specific head
nova: yes — attention mass collapses to one token in head 7 starting ~token 640 consistently
kai: try forcing `--remap-head-order=strict` and add explicit `layout=interleaved` metadata on the converted file. also run a rotary scale sweep 0.65->1.05 step 0.05
lena: for quant, try per-channel symmetric scales and store scale metadata as float32; avoids int4 snapbacks we saw before
miles: add a KV warmup test: repeat a 64-token prefix 3x and record per-head attention entropy over repeats
nova: queued runs: strict remap + rotary 0.85, strict remap + rotary sweep, and fp16 baseline. will attach artifacts
deploy-bot: CI started: onboard/gemma-lite-handshake #821; artifacts expected in ~20m
kai: also capture token alignment maps pre/post-conversion so we can diff embeddings quickly
lena: and include tests with combined diacritics + ZWJ + soft hyphen — those exposed shadowing earlier
miles: if rotary sweep shows >0.6 improvement at 0.9 we can default converter to 0.9 for this variant and document it in the catalog notes
nova: filing ONB-4099 with repro steps and short eval (5 long docs). will update thread with the quality table
kai: one more: plot headwise cosine between pre/post projection rows to auto-detect head permutes
nova: will add that to CI artifact bundle. thanks all, will post results :thumbsup:
